messages:
maya: Quick sync: plan to enable cetus-8k-v2 in catalog tomorrow 14:00-15:30 UTC. Staged thermostat rollout based on telemetry.

Plan:
- prewarm prefixes in us/eu 20m prior
- stages: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% (auto checks between stages)
- fallback order: cetus-8k-v1 (compat float) -> iris-6b for <=64 tokens -> sentinel-7b emergency
- pin compat variant soft for 4h to reduce client churn

Rollback triggers: P95 +160ms for 10m OR error-rate +4% for 5m. Circuit-breaker: 3 failed checks -> 0% for 3m + page.

tonys: For pinning I prefer soft then auto-release. Also exclude ap-south for first pass (warmup slow there).

ops-lee: Add billing token-cost metric alert: >+12% for 10m pause rollout. Wire incident to #incidents and create ephemeral r-2026-512-cetus.

devex-kai: I'll prepare release blurb and examples. Suggest note: "cetus-8k-v2: lower variance on long streams, opt-in staged rollout."

deploy-bot: dry-run OK:
```
$ catalogctl enable --model cetus-8k-v2 --stages 1,5,20,100 --prewarm true --pin soft:4h --exclude ap-south
Simulated plan OK. Rollout token r-2026-512-cetus
```
